notes.title: XP Update Part 2!
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Today the XP Update Part 2  has released! Several changes are included like making the survival stat values visible on HUD, and the ability to gain multiple levels per run, but most importantly permanent stat buffs based on player level. 
During your run several factors are taken into account including distance traveled, entities encountered, and levels finished, which determine the amount of XP you gain each run. This has been adjusted to NOT scale with the total distance traveled anymore. At the beginning of each run you will be given a buff to your total Sanity, Stamina, H20, and hunger based on your player level.

The save select screen has also been adjusted to now display the player level, rather than the total distance traveled.

I want to thank everyone again for all of your support!

for any inquiries or suggestions feel free to reach out in the discussion forums!

-BaddWeather

notes.title: XP Update part 1!
notes.notes:
XP Update Part 1 adds an XP system based on factors like distance traveled and entities encountered, as well as a leveling system specific to each save file. Player level will ultimately determine the rate at which stats drain, the max level for a stat, and how much experience is earned per run.

Issues regarding the accuracy of the distance counter have also been fixed, as well as several other minor bugs.

Part two is coming within a few days and will contain the rest of the features!

Thanks again everyone for all of your support!

-BaddWeather

notes.title: Alpha 1.6 Item Update!
notes.notes:
Update #8:

Persistent Items!

The transition from Demo build to Full build has been divided into 3 major updates, Items, Entities, and Maps. I'm happy to announce a large portion of the planned items have been added to the game, and a rarity system has been assigned. "Common" items", like almond water, snacks, and sanity pills, will remain the same and are lost upon death. "Uncommon" items have been added, like energy drinks, and the fidget spinner, as well as "rare" items which will remain mostly a secret. Uncommon and Rare Items will persist across death, meaning the player can accumulate and save these items over multiple playthroughs, increasing their chances of surviving longer in the Backrooms.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42238353/8969829f8a19f1a8e39cde77fc0c7bfb40300b54.jpg

The fidget spinner will dramatically reduce sanity loss while being spun.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42238353/72625a2181e74c5ee8351815910c6121c23e820b.jpg

The ear muffs are an equipable item that will prevent sanity loss from buzzing lights, but will also make it harder to hear entities.

Furthermore, many other issues have been patched in the latest update, including missing fonts for Russian and Ukrainian localization, menu fixes, and performance updates. Currently, I am looking for individuals who would be willing to help me translate the game accurately. Please reach out if you are interested! 

-BaddWeather/Euclid Games

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 0.6 Update!
notes.notes:
Update #5:

Mechanics and Lore

[previewyoutube=I9YNAnL4sEw;full][/previewyoutube]

As many might have noticed, the trailer for The Backrooms: Found Footage dropped last week, and there were several developments revealed that I have yet to discuss in detail! The first round of entities are complete- this includes all of the strange and anomalous beings you may encounter during levels 0-2. The trailer revealed footage of the most dangerous one yet, the Smiler.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42238353/d6a6dfa6837f915dcdab59e1ec05d5c894a87e9b.jpg

Another apparent change is the visuals, which was to be expected. The main difference is the addition of volumetric fog, which certainly adds to the claustrophobia-inducing element of the Backrooms, and provides a more even distribution of lighting that an office space typically has. 

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42238353/b6a6ddc48472c6465862a57868f09f0f0c5cf037.jpg

The "madness effect" has been upgraded and is now much more intense while being less obstructive. The HUD has also been polished overall and madness and hydration, as of now, will be primarily managed by consuming different substances in the Backrooms- carpet water, and Almond Water being the main two at the moment. 

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42238353/c2940ebdf7a1f3fe1ab34e342dbaadd549c7c3a1.jpg

The plan as of now, is to release a demo by June 13th, the beginning of Steam Game Fest, with the full release following a few weeks after. Currently, the main game will include "Purist" and "Traditional" mode. These modes will be based on different lore, meaning they will differ in length, story, and entities. The demo will include "Purist" mode, with some minor adjustments as to include a few more features. 

Further updates will be posted in the upcoming weeks!

Support the project by adding it to your Wishlist!

Euclid Games/BaddWeather

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 0.2 Update! + Context
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ZvML2ky4u9s;full][/previewyoutube]

Update #1:

Beginnings

About a year ago I began learning Blender. I'd done plenty of art before, but never in a digital space. It took many hours of tutorials, but I finally got to a point where I considered myself familiar with the process. I enjoyed making renders, and even tackled the Backrooms very early on with a piece titled "Liminal Burger." As things have progressed I've wondered how to apply this knowledge of CGI in a new way, and as soon as I begin my search, Epic Games announces Unreal Engine 5 Early Access is now available.. the rest is recent history.

The intention is to create a Backrooms game that is inspired by Kane Pixel's recent Youtube series while still remaining true to all of the original canons. Based on research from sources including- but not limited to the official Wikidot, the game will eventually feature 3 game modes based on 3 of the existing canons; Purist, Traditional, and the Main 9.

Seeing as one of my first projects in Blender was creating The Backrooms, I decided it was a good starting point for creating my first game. After finding an effective pipeline from Blender to Unreal, I experimented with several maze generation methods and finally ended up utilizing a Blender plug-in called Maze Generator by Nathan Hild, which provided the variation in room size to achieve the iconic Backrooms look. The lighting is prone to changes at this point, as optimization progresses. 

Further updates will be posted later in the week!
